title: Focus a window
summary: Switch to a live client matched by class, title, or alias.
when: A client whose class/title matches target is mapped.
refuse: the one on the left of the red one

title: Fullscreen
summary: Fullscreen the focused or named client.
when: Target client exists and is not already fullscreen.
walk: focus if needed, then hyprctl dispatch fullscreen 1

title: Switch workspace
summary: Named or numbered workspace on the current monitor.
when: Workspace id is in the live set or is creatable.

title: Move window to workspace
summary: Move focused (or named) client silently, then optionally follow.
when: A focused client exists.

title: Close window
summary: Close focused or named client. Named 'other browser' uses kill_other logic.
when: Target client exists.
walk: hyprctl dispatch killactive or focus then kill

title: Toggle floating
summary: Float or tile the focused window.
when: A focused client exists.

title: Other monitor
summary: Move focus to the next monitor.
when: More than one monitor is connected.

title: Open beside
summary: Launch an allowlisted app in a split next to the focused window.
when: App is allowlisted.
examples: open a terminal beside the editor

title: What is focused
summary: Return class/title/workspace of the active window.
when: Always when Hyprland is up.

title: Where is an app
summary: Workspace of a named class.
when: Target client exists.

title: Nudge volume
summary: Change default sink by a notch. 'A bit' is 5%, never a model-invented percent.
when: Default sink exists. Up is live only if volume < 1.0.

title: Mute sink
summary: Mute the default output.
when: Sink exists and is not muted.

title: Unmute sink
summary: Unmute the default output.
when: Sink is muted.

title: Headphones
summary: Set default sink to the headphones node if present.
when: A headphones sink is in wpctl status.

title: Speakers / TV
summary: Set default sink to speakers or TV.
when: Named sink exists.

title: How loud
summary: Return current volume and mute.
when: Sink exists.

title: Open allowlisted app
summary: Exec if not running; focus if it is. Allowlist only.
when: App is on the allowlist.
walk: if running: wm.focus; else hyprctl dispatch exec <bin>

title: Is it open
summary: Whether an allowlisted app already has a client.
when: Always.

title: Mail from someone
summary: Count and latest subjects from a contact. Not a summary essay.
when: Mail module online and speaker owns the account. Hidden if guest occupants.
examples: have I received any emails from Dave
refuse: email dave that i'll be late

title: Unread count
summary: How many unread in the inbox.
when: Mail online, private session.
examples: don't read it out — just yes or no

title: Open last from contact
summary: Open the latest message from a contact in the mail app. Confirm if others present.
when: At least one message from contact. Confirm page if occupants > 1.

title: Flag for later
summary: Pin/flag the latest matching message. Does not send.
when: A current mail context exists.

title: Next unread mail
summary: Who has the next unread mail, and how many. Not a body.
when: Mail online, private session. Hidden for a guest or an empty who.

title: Archive mail
summary: Archive the current mail. Confirm. Does not send, reply, or forward.
when: Mail online. Hidden for a guest. Confirm stays on.

title: Mark mail read
summary: Mark the current mail read. Does not send, reply, or forward.
when: Mail online, private session.

title: Play / pause
summary: Toggle the active player.
when: A player is available.

title: Skip
summary: Next track / chapter.
when: Player is playing or paused.

title: Previous
summary: Previous track.
when: Player exists.

title: Now playing
summary: Title / artist / player name.
when: Player exists.

title: Hide buddy
summary: Dismiss the overlay.
when: BuckyBoi is visible.

title: Start listen
summary: Enter Listening if the gate allows. Usually a BuckyBoi-local pose.
when: Gate passes for who.

title: Mute mic path
summary: Local ASR mute, not the PipeWire sink.
when: Mic path is open.

title: Who is here
summary: Auth chip + occupants as the house currently believes.
when: Always.
examples: who does the house think is here

title: Apply named scene
summary: GlassSpear recipe. Never 'make it cozy' — only authored ids.
when: Scene id is in the library and policy allows it for occupants.

title: Lock private panes
summary: Tear down personal pages on a shared surface.
when: Surface has private panes or guests arriving.

title: Guest mode
summary: Force shared_only and hide private pages.
when: Always.

title: Active scene
summary: What recipe a room is on.
when: Controller has a session for that surface.
examples: what scene is the living room on

title: Handoff media
summary: Move now-playing to another surface. Later GlassSpear epic; page exists so it can be tested as denied until wired.
when: Handoff driver is enabled and target surface is online.

title: Last notification
summary: App + summary of the latest notification.
when: History is non-empty.

title: Nudge lights
summary: Room group brightness by a notch.
when: Room light group exists.

title: Lights off
summary: Named room group off.
when: Group exists.

title: Start timer
summary: Authored durations only.
when: No timer, or replace is allowed.

title: Add time
summary: Add five minutes to a running timer.
when: A timer is running.

title: Time left
summary: Seconds remaining.
when: Timer running.

title: Cancel timer
summary: Stop the running timer.
when: Timer running.

title: What's next
summary: Next calendar event for the speaker. Hidden with guests.
when: Calendar online and speaker owns the account. Hidden if guest occupants.

title: Today's count
summary: How many remaining events today, plus a busy bucket. Not a second page.
when: Calendar online, private session.

title: Nudge screen brightness
summary: Panel brightness by a notch. Separate from room lights.
when: A panel is present.

title: Night light
summary: Toggle the authored night-light preset. Not a free kelvin.
when: Night-light preset exists.
walk: hyprctl hyprsunset temperature 3500 or authored toggle

title: Nudge climate
summary: Room climate group by one degree. Never a model-invented setpoint.
when: Climate entity exists in this room.

title: Climate off
summary: Turn the room climate group off.
when: Climate entity exists and is on.

title: Screenshot
summary: Capture the focused output to Pictures. Confirm if guest present.
when: An output is focused.

title: Weather here
summary: Short condition for this location. Not packing advice.
when: Weather snap is non-null.

title: Focus a browser
summary: Focus a mapped browser, or exec its binary when allowlisted and unmapped.
when: A client matches app, or the app is allowlisted and bins contains its binary.

title: Is the browser open
summary: Whether an allowlisted browser has a window, and whether it is focused.
when: App is on the allowlist.

title: New tab
summary: Open a tab in the named or focused browser.
when: A browser client matches and Ctrl+T is armed.

title: Close tab
summary: Close the current tab. Not the window.
when: A browser client matches and Ctrl+W is armed.

title: Reopen tab
summary: Reopen the last closed tab.
when: A browser client matches and Ctrl+Shift+T is armed.

title: Next tab
summary: Select the next tab.
when: A browser client matches and Ctrl+Tab is armed.

title: Previous tab
summary: Select the previous tab.
when: A browser client matches and Ctrl+Shift+Tab is armed.

title: Pin tab
summary: Pin the current tab. Reserved until a per-app chord exists.
when: Reserved — no shared chord.

title: Mute tab
summary: Mute the current tab. Reserved until a per-app chord exists.
when: Reserved — no shared chord.

title: Browser back
summary: History back. Not media previous.
when: A browser client matches and Alt+Left is armed.

title: Browser forward
summary: History forward.
when: A browser client matches and Alt+Right is armed.

title: Reload
summary: Reload the page.
when: A browser client matches and Ctrl+R is armed.

title: Hard reload
summary: Reload, bypassing cache.
when: A browser client matches and Ctrl+Shift+R is armed.

title: Browser home
summary: Open the home page. No free URL.
when: A browser client matches and Alt+Home is armed.

title: Find in page
summary: Open the find bar. No query string.
when: A browser client matches and Ctrl+F is armed.

title: Zoom the page
summary: Zoom in or out by a notch. Little is one chord, lot is three.
when: A browser client matches and Ctrl+plus or Ctrl+minus is armed.

title: Reset zoom
summary: Reset page zoom.
when: A browser client matches and Ctrl+0 is armed.

title: Reader mode
summary: Reserved until a per-app chord exists.
when: Reserved — no shared chord.

title: Browser fullscreen
summary: Fullscreen the page with F11. Not the window-manager fullscreen.
when: A browser client matches and F11 is armed.

title: Picture in picture
summary: Reserved until a per-app chord exists.
when: Reserved — no shared chord.

title: Bookmark page
summary: Bookmark into a discovered folder. Reserved until a chord exists. The folder is not a path.
when: Reserved — no shared chord. Folder must be in lists.bookmark_folder.

title: Downloads
summary: How many downloads, as a bucket. No names and no URLs.
when: downloads is set, and the caller is not a guest.

title: Cancel download
summary: Cancel the current download. Reserved until a chord exists.
when: Reserved — no shared chord.

title: Private window
summary: Firefox private window. Chrome and Chromium stay reserved.
when: Firefox client matches and Ctrl+Shift+P is armed. Other apps have no builtin.

title: Translate page
summary: Reserved until a per-app chord exists.
when: Reserved — no shared chord.

title: Developer tools
summary: Open developer tools. Owner only.
when: Owner, a browser client matches, and Ctrl+Shift+I is armed.

title: Firefox container
summary: Switch the Firefox multi-account container. No builtin chord.
when: Dead unless class is firefox. No builtin chord.

title: Container tab
summary: Open a tab in a Firefox container. No builtin chord. Not send-tab.
when: Dead unless class is firefox. No builtin chord.

title: Chrome profile
summary: Switch a Chrome or Chromium profile. Reserved until a chord exists.
when: Reserved. Dead unless class is chrome or chromium.

title: Chrome profile window
summary: Open a window for a Chrome or Chromium profile. Reserved.
when: Reserved. Dead unless class is chrome or chromium.

title: Collapse tab group
summary: Collapse the current Chrome or Chromium tab group. Reserved.
when: Reserved. Dead unless class is chrome or chromium.

title: Next Zen workspace
summary: Forward Zen workspace. Alt+Ctrl+E from the Zen shortcuts table.
when: Class zen. Alt+Ctrl+E is armed.

title: Previous Zen workspace
summary: Backward Zen workspace. Alt+Ctrl+Q from the Zen shortcuts table.
when: Class zen. Alt+Ctrl+Q is armed.

title: Zen workspace index
summary: Switch to Zen workspace 1-5. Not set by default, so reserved.
when: Reserved. Zen does not bind workspace index by default.

title: New Zen workspace
summary: New Zen workspace. Reserved. Confirm if a chord is later copied in.
when: Reserved. No default chord. Confirm when a chord is copied in.

title: Zen compact mode
summary: Reserved. The shortcuts table and the compact-mode page disagree.
when: Reserved. Do not guess Alt+Ctrl+C or Ctrl+S.

title: Zen sidebar
summary: Toggle the floating sidebar. Alt+Ctrl+S from the Zen shortcuts table.
when: Class zen. Alt+Ctrl+S is armed.

title: Zen split view
summary: Split the selected tabs. Horizontal H, vertical V, grid G.
when: Class zen. Alt+Ctrl+H, V, or G from the layout slot.

title: Unsplit Zen tabs
summary: Close split view. Alt+Ctrl+U from the Zen shortcuts table.
when: Class zen. Alt+Ctrl+U is armed.

title: Open glance
summary: Reserved. Glance has no default key. Escape is not a glance chord.
when: Reserved. No default key.

title: Close glance
summary: Reserved. Escape is not a glance chord.
when: Reserved. No dedicated key.

title: Zen web panel
summary: Open a named web panel. No per-panel default chord.
when: Reserved. Alt+Ctrl+X is the AI sidebar, a different door.

title: Zen essentials
summary: Reserved. Essentials have no default chord.
when: Reserved. No default chord.

title: Move tab to Zen workspace
summary: Reserved. No default chord for moving a tab between Zen workspaces.
when: Reserved. No default chord.

title: Focus a terminal
summary: Focus a mapped terminal, or exec_cmd its binary when allowlisted, unmapped, and bins contains it.
when: A terminal client matches app, or the app is allowlisted and bins contains its binary.

title: New terminal window
summary: Send the app's new-window chord. Dead until that terminal is mapped. Never exec.
when: That terminal is already mapped and its new-window chord is known.

title: New terminal tab
summary: New tab chord where the terminal has one. Foot and Alacritty stay reserved.
when: A matching terminal is mapped and a new-tab chord is known.

title: Close terminal
summary: Close chord for the mapped terminal. Foot has none.
when: A matching terminal is mapped and a close chord is known.

title: Next terminal
summary: Cycle to the next terminal tab. Not next tab — that is the browser.
when: A matching terminal is mapped and a next chord is known.

title: Previous terminal
summary: Cycle to the previous terminal tab. Not go back.
when: A matching terminal is mapped and a previous chord is known.

title: Terminal font notch
summary: Bigger or smaller font by a notch. Little is one chord, lot is three. Unnamed amount is little.
when: A terminal client matches and a font chord is known.

title: Focus a file manager
summary: Focus a mapped file manager. Unmapped does not exec.
when: That file manager's class is mapped.

title: Open an authored folder
summary: Open home, downloads, pictures, or documents. The path is written in the driver. The id must be in lists.dir.
when: dir is an authored id in lists.dir, and the app is mapped or allowlisted with its binary in bins.

title: Back in files
summary: Alt+Left in Nautilus, Nemo, Thunar, and Dolphin. Not go back.
when: A matching file manager is mapped and Alt+Left is known. Yazi stays reserved.

title: Parent folder
summary: Alt+Up to the parent folder. Not a free path.
when: A matching file manager is mapped and Alt+Up is known. Yazi stays reserved.

title: Hidden files
summary: Ctrl+H in Nautilus, Nemo, and Thunar. Dolphin and Yazi stay reserved.
when: A matching file manager is mapped and Ctrl+H is known.

title: Sort files
summary: Sort by name or date. No default chord, so the door stays reserved.
when: Reserved. No default sort chord.

title: Move to trash
summary: Confirm before trash. Delete is unmodified and is not armed. Not a free delete.
when: Reserved. No armable trash chord. Confirm stays on.

title: Focus notes
summary: Focus a mapped notes app. Does not exec.
when: That notes class is mapped.

title: Notes vault
summary: Switch to an authored vault id. Private. No text and no default chord.
when: Private. Reserved until a vault chord exists.

title: Daily note
summary: Open today's journal. Private. Armed only for Logseq Alt+J.
when: Private. Logseq Alt+J when mapped. Obsidian and Joplin stay reserved.

title: Notes sidebar
summary: Toggle the notes sidebar. No default chord we can send.
when: Reserved. Joplin's F10 cannot arm, and Obsidian has no default.

title: Focus a reader
summary: Focus a mapped reader. Does not exec.
when: That reader class is mapped.

title: Next page
summary: Ctrl+Page Down in Evince and Papers. Not a page number. Not next tab.
when: Evince or Papers is mapped. Zathura and Foliate stay reserved.

title: Previous page
summary: Ctrl+Page Up in Evince and Papers. Not go back.
when: Evince or Papers is mapped. Zathura and Foliate stay reserved.

title: Next chapter
summary: Next chapter only. No page number and no default chord.
when: Reserved. No default chapter chord.

title: Previous chapter
summary: Previous chapter only. Not go back. No default chord.
when: Reserved. No default chapter chord.

title: Reader zoom
summary: Zoom the document by a notch. Little is one chord, lot is three. Not the browser.
when: Evince, Papers, or Foliate is mapped. Zathura zoom stays reserved.

title: Reader dark mode
summary: Zathura recolor is Ctrl+R. Other readers stay reserved.
when: Zathura is mapped. Evince, Papers, and Foliate stay reserved.

title: Focus chat
summary: Focus a mapped Signal, Element, or Vesktop window. Discord's class is Vesktop. Does not exec.
when: That chat class is mapped.

title: Mute chat app
summary: Mute that chat app. Not the default sink. Reserved: no modifier chord.
when: Reserved. Discord Ctrl+Shift+M is the microphone, not this door.

title: Mark chat read
summary: Mark that chat app read. Reserved: no modifier chord. Not mail.
when: Reserved until a modifier chord exists.

title: Chat unread
summary: Unread bucket for one chat app. Private. Missing snap key is dead, not zero.
when: chatUnread has that app id. Hidden for a guest.

title: Suspend
summary: Suspend the machine. Owner, and confirm is a separate flag. Not DPMS.
when: Caller is the owner. A guest flag, an empty who, or unknown fails even when who is jim.

title: Reboot
summary: Reboot the machine. Owner plus confirm. Dry-run only.
when: Caller is the owner. Guest is not the owner.

title: Power off
summary: Power the machine off. Owner plus confirm. Not screens off.
when: Caller is the owner. Guest is not the owner.

title: Idle inhibit
summary: Reserved. hl.dsp.force_idle forces idle and ignores inhibitors. It is not a latch, and there is no systemd-inhibit door.
when: Reserved until a daemon can hold an inhibitor. Not force_idle.

title: Output brightness
summary: Brightness notch for an authored output class. hdmi or edp. Dead when that output is absent. No resolution or refresh.
when: The output class is in lists.output or is the classified focused output.

title: Display layout
summary: Authored layout id only. Reserved: applying it needs a mode, and neither brightnessctl nor hl.dsp can do that without a resolution.
when: Reserved even when lists.layout contains the id. Absent when it does not.

title: Dismiss all
summary: Dismiss every notification. Confirm. read_last stays private.
when: Notification history is non-empty.

title: Split ratio
summary: Dwindle splitratio notch. Little is 0.1, lot is 0.25. Not a typed ratio.
when: Compositor is up. The ratio is a driver constant.

title: Next in group
summary: Next window in the group. Not media next and not next tab.
when: Compositor is up.

title: Layout
summary: Switch the authored layout message to dwindle or master. Not a resolution.
when: The layout slot is dwindle or master.

title: Focus a music player
summary: Focus a mapped player, or exec the binary when it is allowlisted, unmapped, and in bins. Not a volume door.
when: Mapped, or allowlisted and the binary is in bins. Unmapped transport stays dead.

title: Pause the music
summary: playerctl play-pause for one named player. Not bare pause, and not the sink.
when: That player class is mapped. Unmapped does not exec.

title: Next song
summary: playerctl next for one player. Not bare next.
when: That player class is mapped.

title: Seek the song
summary: playerctl position notch. Little is 10 seconds, lot is 30. Not a percent.
when: That player class is mapped.

title: Play a playlist
summary: Authored playlist id from lists.playlist. Dead when the id is absent. Not a free title.
when: The player is mapped and lists.playlist contains the id.

title: Focus a video player
summary: Focus mpv, vlc, or jellyfin. Exec only for this page, and only when allowlisted, unmapped, and in bins.
when: Mapped, or the focus exec path. Other video acts need a client.

title: Video chapter
summary: VLC Shift+N. mpv and jellyfin chapter keys are unmodified, so they stay reserved. Not next chapter in a book.
when: A matching client and a modifier chord. Not bare next.

title: Seek the video
summary: playerctl position notch. Little is 10 seconds, lot is 30. Not a title.
when: That player class is mapped.

title: Toggle subtitles
summary: VLC Shift+V. mpv's sub key is unmodified v, so mpv and jellyfin stay reserved.
when: A matching client and a modifier chord.

title: Video fullscreen
summary: Reserved. mpv and vlc fullscreen is an unmodified f, which cannot arm. Not wm.fullscreen.
when: Reserved until a modifier chord exists.

title: Video picture in picture
summary: Reserved. No modifier PiP chord on mpv, vlc, or jellyfin.
when: Reserved until a modifier chord exists.

title: Focus an image viewer
summary: Focus loupe or imv. Exec only for this page when allowlisted, unmapped, and in bins.
when: Mapped, or the focus exec path.

title: Next image
summary: Reserved. Loupe and imv next keys are unmodified arrows.
when: Reserved. Not bare next and not next tab.

title: Zoom the picture
summary: Loupe Ctrl+plus or Ctrl+minus. imv zoom-in is Shift+plus. Lot repeats the chord three times. imv zoom-out stays reserved.
when: A matching client and a modifier chord.

title: Trash the picture
summary: Confirm, but Delete is unmodified so the door stays reserved.
when: Reserved. Confirm is set for when a modifier chord exists.

title: Focus an editor project
summary: Focus a mapped editor, or exec its binary when the project is in lists.project and the app is allowlisted, unmapped, and in bins. The walk is not a path.
when: The project id is in lists.project. Mapped focuses the window. Otherwise exec only if allowlisted and bins contains the binary.

title: Save in the editor
summary: Ctrl+S in Code, VSCodium, and Zed. nvim, helix, and emacs stay reserved.
when: A matching client and a save chord. Does not exec.

title: Close an editor tab
summary: Ctrl+W in Code, VSCodium, and Zed. Not close tab and not close this.
when: A matching client and a close chord.

title: Next editor tab
summary: Ctrl+PageDown in Code, VSCodium, and Zed. Not next tab.
when: A matching client and a next-tab chord.

title: Split the editor
summary: Ctrl+backslash in Code and VSCodium. Zed's split is a sequence. nvim and helix stay reserved.
when: A matching client and a split chord.

title: Format the editor
summary: Shift+Alt+F in Code and VSCodium. Zed is Ctrl+Shift+I. The others stay reserved.
when: A matching client and a format chord.

title: Save the spreadsheet
summary: Ctrl+S in LibreOffice. Does not exec.
when: A LibreOffice client is mapped.

title: Zoom the sheet
summary: A notch. LibreOffice zoom has no modifier chord, so the door stays reserved.
when: Reserved until a modifier chord exists.

title: Next sheet
summary: Ctrl+PageDown in Calc. Not next and not next tab.
when: A LibreOffice client is mapped.

title: Save the drawing
summary: Ctrl+S in GIMP, Krita, and Inkscape. Darktable stays reserved.
when: A matching client and a save chord.

title: Undo the drawing
summary: Ctrl+Z in GIMP, Krita, and Inkscape. Not undo close tab. Darktable stays reserved.
when: A matching client and an undo chord.

title: Zoom the canvas
summary: Krita zoom is Ctrl+plus or Ctrl+minus. Lot repeats three times. GIMP and Inkscape zoom keys are unmodified. Darktable stays reserved.
when: A matching client and a modifier zoom chord.

title: Export a png
summary: Inkscape export-to-png is Ctrl+Shift+E and confirms. GIMP, Krita, and darktable stay reserved.
when: A matching client and a png export chord. Confirm before the walk.

title: Show the launcher
summary: Show fuzzel, or walker when that is the named or only binary. No query and no free command. The user types.
when: The named binary is in bins. Unnamed prefers fuzzel, then walker.

title: Clipboard kind
summary: Kind text, image, or empty, plus a count bucket. Dead when the kind is missing. Never the bytes.
when: clipboardKind is text, image, or empty.

title: Clear the clipboard
summary: Confirm, then cliphist wipe or wl-copy -c. Does not print or copy a password.
when: cliphist or wl-copy is in bins.

title: Set wallpaper
summary: Authored wallpaper id from lists.wallpaper. The walk is swww img plus that id, not a path and not hyprpicker.
when: The id is in lists.wallpaper and swww is in bins.
refuse: set the wallpaper to a path

title: Picked color
summary: Return pickedHex. Dead when it is missing or not a hex color. Does not exec hyprpicker and does not apply a color.
when: pickedHex is a 6-digit hex color.
refuse: set the wallpaper to that color

title: Effect preset
summary: EasyEffects preset enum from lists.fx_preset. Reserved: no confirmed chord and no plugin graph.
when: Reserved until a chord exists. The id must be in lists.fx_preset.

title: Effect source
summary: EasyEffects source enum from lists.source. Reserved: no confirmed chord and no routing graph.
when: Reserved until a chord exists. The id must be in lists.source.

title: Start screen recording
summary: Confirm, then wf-recorder if it is in bins, else gpu-screen-recorder. Dead if neither is. No GPU probe. Not a screenshot.
when: wf-recorder or gpu-screen-recorder is in bins.

title: Stop screen recording
summary: Confirm, then interrupt the same recorder binary. Dead if neither recorder is in bins.
when: wf-recorder or gpu-screen-recorder is in bins.

title: Connect VPN
summary: Confirm, then nmcli connection up for a name in lists.vpn. Not down, not an SSID, not DNS. The fixture name is home. Live names come from nmcli type vpn or wireguard.
when: The name is in lists.vpn and nmcli is in bins. Empty list or any other name is dead.

title: Connect bluetooth device
summary: bluetoothctl connect for the allowlisted device id. headphones is the enum. Not pair and not a MAC from the utterance.
when: Adapter is on, bluetoothctl is in bins, and the id is in lists.bt_device.

title: Disconnect bluetooth device
summary: bluetoothctl disconnect for the same allowlisted device. Not pair.
when: Adapter is on, bluetoothctl is in bins, and the id is in lists.bt_device.

title: Power profile
summary: powerprofilesctl set of power-saver, balanced, or performance from lists.power_profile. No fan percent.
when: The id is in lists.power_profile and powerprofilesctl is in bins.

title: Battery
summary: Bucket full, high, mid, low, critical, or ac. Dead when battery is missing. Not a percent and not a fan.
when: battery is a fraction from 0 to 1. None is dead, including when on AC.

title: Disk space
summary: Bucket ok, low, or full from the free fraction. Dead when diskFree is missing. Not a path.
when: diskFree is a fraction from 0 to 1. None is dead.

title: Timeshift snapshot
summary: Owner and confirm. timeshift --create --scripted when that binary is in bins. Not format and not delete.
when: Caller is the owner and timeshift is in bins. Guest is not the owner.

title: Pending updates
summary: Bucket none, few, or many from updatesPending. Dead when the field is missing. Not a package list.
when: updatesPending is a count. None is dead. Zero is the none bucket.

title: Upgrade the system
summary: Owner and confirm. One fixed full-upgrade command: pacman -Syu, else dnf upgrade, else apt full-upgrade. No package name.
when: Caller is the owner and one of those binaries is in bins. Guest is not the owner.

title: Vault unlocked
summary: Bool from secretsUnlocked. Dead when the field is missing. Private. Never a password, a secret, or ok.
when: secretsUnlocked is Some. None is dead. Guest and empty who do not see it. A bare app name does not ask.

title: Lock the vault
summary: Private. Reserved until a lock chord exists. Not the screen lock.
when: Reserved. No vault lock chord is authored.

title: Autotype
summary: Private and confirm. Reserved because autotype would send secret bytes. Not a password and not a keystroke sequence.
when: Always reserved. A chord that types the secret is not a door.

title: Sync status
summary: Syncthing or KDE Connect status. Reserved. No binary is claimed and no status is invented.
when: Reserved. There is no sync status field.

title: Ping a paired device
summary: Reserved. KDE Connect ping is not claimed. Send-file stays refused.
when: Reserved. No ping command is authored.

title: Start a box
summary: Name from lists.box. Reserved because no box runtime is claimed. Not an image.
when: The name is in lists.box. The walk stays reserved.

title: Stop a box
summary: Confirm. Name from lists.box. Reserved because no box runtime is claimed.
when: The name is in lists.box. Confirm, and the walk stays reserved.

title: Focus a game library
summary: Focus a mapped Steam or Heroic window. Unmapped stays reserved. Does not exec a binary.
when: A client class matches the app. Otherwise reserved. No exec.

title: Play a game
summary: Title from lists.game. The fixture id is celeste. Reserved: no launch command and no store URL. Buy stays refused.
when: The title is in lists.game. The walk stays reserved.

title: Record in OBS
summary: Confirm. Live only when an OBS window is mapped, and the walk stays reserved. Naming obs does not start or stop the screen recorder. Stream stays refused.
when: An obs client is mapped. Otherwise reserved, so the screen recorder is not walked. Not a stream.

title: OBS scene
summary: Scene enum desk or cam from lists.obs_scene. Reserved until a chord exists.
when: The scene is in lists.obs_scene. No chord, so reserved.

title: Print
summary: Confirm. Reserved because the printer command is not claimed. N copies stay refused.
when: Reserved. A copy count is refused before the page.

title: Scan
summary: Confirm. Reserved because the scanner command is not claimed. N copies stay refused.
when: Reserved. A copy count is refused before the page.

title: Solaar battery
summary: Bucket full, high, mid, low, or critical from solaarBattery. Dead when the fraction is missing. Not the system battery and not a percent.
when: solaarBattery is a fraction from 0 to 1. None is dead.

title: Solaar DPI
summary: Amount notch. Reserved until a chord exists. Not a solaar config line and not a percent.
when: Reserved. No solaar chord.
